## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or friction you're trying to address.

## Proposed solution

What would you like RepoMedic AI to do?

## Does this fit the product principle?

RepoMedic AI's principle is **evidence first, AI second, human control
always**. If this is a new scanner check, it should be deterministic,
produce real evidence, and avoid unsupported claims. If this touches the
AI layer, it should interpret existing findings rather than inventing
new facts. A short note on how your idea fits (or intentionally departs
from) this is helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't pick them.
